Our services provide an end-to-end solution for operators wanting to launch a standalone Sportsbook or bolster their existing offering with an innovative sports betting product. Our vision is to create the world’s leading sports betting experiences, together with our partners. Shape Kambi’s global tax strategy as we grow This is an opportunity to lead and shape the global tax function at Kambi, bringing together strategy, governance, international expansion and commercial decision-making in a highly visible leadership role. Reporting directly to the CFO, you’ll have the scope to influence how Kambi manages tax across its international operations, while building scalable processes and providing clear, commercially grounded advice to senior stakeholders. We work in a hybrid way, combining flexibility with time together in person. You’ll spend three days each week in the office, collaborating with colleagues and building the relationships that will be central to your success in the role. About the role As Head of Tax, you’ll lead Kambi’s global approach to tax, ensuring our operations remain compliant, efficient and aligned with the needs of the business. Your remit will span tax strategy and governance, compliance and reporting, transfer pricing, international expansion and tax transformation. You’ll also act as a trusted business partner, helping colleagues navigate the tax implications of contracts, new markets, strategic initiatives and potential transactions. This is a role for someone who enjoys combining technical depth with commercial thinking. You’ll have the opportunity not only to manage today’s requirements, but also to strengthen how the tax function operates for the future. What you’ll do You’ll: Shape Kambi’s group tax strategy and governance , maintaining an effective tax risk and control framework and providing clear reporting to the Audit Committee and Board. Lead global tax compliance and reporting , including tax returns, provisioning and tax accounting under IFRS, while ensuring compliance with relevant international tax treaties. Own our transfer pricing approach , maintaining OECD-compliant documentation and leading transfer pricing planning, strategy and governance. Support Kambi’s international growth , assessing the tax implications of new markets, products and territories, and leading tax due diligence and structuring reviews. Partner with the business on commercial decisions , providing practical recommendations on areas such as contract structures and withholding tax, while supporting M&A and other strategic projects. Manage tax authority and regulatory matters , leading relationships with tax authorities, audits and dispute resolution, and keeping Kambi informed of relevant regulatory developments. Transform and strengthen the tax function , improving processes and controls, increasing automation, reducing manual dependency and creating robust documentation and playbooks. Build long-term resilience , developing scalable ways of working and strengthening succession and knowledge continuity across the function. What you’ll bring We’re looking for someone with the technical expertise and judgement to lead an international tax function, combined with the ability to turn complex issues into practical recommendations. You’ll bring: A recognised tax or accounting qualification, such as CTA, ACA, CA, CPA or equivalent. At least seven years’ experience in international tax. Experience leading group tax within a multinational organisation. Strong transfer pricing expertise. A commercial mindset and the ability to balance tax, regulatory and broader business considerations. The confidence to communicate clearly and influence stakeholders at senior levels. Strong judgement, integrity and a collaborative, proactive approach. Nice to have Experience in one or more of the following would be useful, but isn’t essential: A listed company environment. A technology or digital platform business. B2B, SaaS or gaming businesses. Practical details Reporting to: CFO Working approach: Hybrid, with three days per week in the office Location: London or Malta Kambi's ongoing commitment to Diversity and Inclusion in the workplace If you require any reasonable adjustment during the recruitment process, please notify your recruiter, who will assist you however they can. Diversity and inclusion is at the heart of who we are and who we aim to be. While we are proud of the positive and inclusive company culture we have created, we know we can do so much more. Kambi constantly evolves its Diversity and Inclusion strategy to ensure it becomes an even more inclusive and positive place to work, with the core management team reaffirming its commitment to delivering on employee feedback. Creating an inclusive environment We believe Kambi's greatest strength is the collective talent of our employees. Kambi is committed to ensuring we create an inclusive work environment where everyone can feel valued, thrive and achieve their potential, regardless of who they are or what their background is. We know that it is only by having a balance of different voices, values and opinions that Kambi is able to be the market leader it is today. #wearekambi

review_candidates.description: Role and Facility Information Northern Health is seeking to expand the group of Emergency Physicians working in the brand new Ksyen Regional Hospital in Terrace, BC. Ksyen Regional Hospital Emergency Department has double coverage between 8am and midnight. The day is divided into 4 shifts, two 8am to 5pm shifts and two 5pm to midnight shifts. Overnight shifts are single coverage from midnight to 8am. Full time employment is approximately 12-14 shifts per month. At 0.5 FTE and 0.75 FTE, this will include approximately 2 and 3 overnights per month, respectively. Scheduling is quite flexible with the opportunity to accommodate vacation requests and other clinical or teaching interests. The FTE component is negotiable, and CCFP-EM or RCPSC-EM are preferred by not required. The Emergency Department is very well supported by outstanding specialists and services including Internal Medicine with a 6 bed ICU, General Surgery, Plastic Surgery, Urology, Obstetrics and Gynecology, Pediatrics, Ophthalmology and Radiology. We have CT, MRI, and ultrasound on site. Ksyen Regional Hospital welcomed its first patients in November 2024. More than double the size of the previous hospital, it is a center for trauma services, acute care, surgical services pathology, radiology, clinical support and pharmacy services for the Northwest region. The hospital staff prides itself on delivering culturally safe care to our Indigenous populations. 42 Acute Care Beds 20 bed Psychiatry unit 4 surgical suites, including a dedicated Orthopedics OR 6 ICU Beds, with potential to expand to 8 20 Bed Emergency Department with 2 Trauma Bays Large Ambulatory Care Unit Community Cancer clinic Hemodialysis Unit Pediatric Care Space MRI, CT, and Nuclear Medicine services The new hospital will also include a Tier 3 neonatal intensive care unit and special care nursery, which will provide community-based antenatal and postnatal services, education and parenting support to pregnant individuals. Terrace is proud to support 2 UBC Family Medicine Residents per year as well as 3 Medical Students from the UBC Integrated Community Clerkship program. In addition to teaching, there are opportunities to lead simulations and journal clubs, among other CMEs activities. Terrace is situated on the traditional territory of the Ts'msyen or “Tsimshian” people. Ts’msyen means “Inside the Skeena River” and the community is built at the confluence of the Kitsumkalum River into the Skeena River. Snow-capped mountains, pristine glacier-fed rivers, lakes and streams all add to the beauty of this community. After work you can enjoy the exceptional outdoor recreational activities offered by the Pacific Northwest. Whether it’s mountain biking, skiing, snowmobiling, hiking, paddling, fishing, or trail running, there’s no shortage of outdoor opportunities in Terrace. From spring to fall enjoy an ever growing network of mountain bike trails supported by the Terrace Off Road Cycling Association (TORCA). During the winter, Shames Mountain plays host to an incredibly welcoming and family friendly ski community with backcountry access to endless backcountry terrain. Terrace is a vibrant, entrepreneurial, and friendly community with a medical catchment area of approximately 31000. Historically built upon the forestry industry, Terrace has grown into a regional service town with some of the biggest employers in the Northwest with a strong presence in construction, trades, manufacturing, and tourism. There are three secondary and six elementary schools, a Northwest Community College, and a University of British Columbia campus. We invite experienced, newly graduated, and USA certified physicians to come check out the beautiful Pacific Northwest! If rewarding professional opportunities and outstanding lifestyle are your priority, we look forward to hearing from you! review_candidates.title: Director of Supplier Manufacturing Development
review_candidates.description: Join Our Team At Cohu Malaysia, we are committed to driving innovation and excellence in the semiconductor industry. Our mission is to create a dynamic and inclusive work environment where every team member feels a sense of belonging and has the opportunity to make a meaningful impact. By joining us, you will be part of a collaborative and forward-thinking workforce dedicated to shaping the future of technology. Unleash your Potential We are seeking a Director, Supplier Manufacturing Development to build and lead Cohu’s new supplier manufacturing organization, developing the team, operating model and global partnerships. Impact You Will Make: Build and lead Cohu's new Supplier Manufacturing Development organization from the ground up — define its charter, hire and develop the team, set the operating rhythm, and establish how it works with Supply Chain, Quality and Engineering worldwide. Serve as Cohu's senior manufacturing authority inside the supply base: walk a supplier's factory floor and form a fast, accurate judgment of whether that factory is well run — flow, layout, equipment capability, tooling, maintenance, changeover, planning, operator skill, yield and throughput — rather than whether its documentation passes an audit. Raise the real manufacturing capability of the Cohu supplier base — capacity, cycle time, yield, cost and on-time delivery — through hands-on improvement work carried out at the supplier's site. Focus will be primarily in Asia. Lead large, critical capability and improvement projects at strategic suppliers, personally on the floor when the situation demands it. Build the team: define roles and structure, recruit and develop Supplier Development Engineers and managers primarily in Asia, build the budget and metrics, and create the operating processes for an organization that does not exist today. Personally assess supplier factories — layout and material flow, equipment condition and process capability, tooling, maintenance, changeover and setup, production planning, inventory, shop-floor management and workforce capability — and convert that assessment into a specific, negotiated improvement plan with the supplier's leadership. Act as the deep technical expert in at least one core manufacturing process (for example precision machining, plating and surface finishing, mechanical and electro-mechanical assembly, sheet metal, molding or weldments) and build a team whose combined expertise covers the remaining processes critical to Cohu. Own the supplier capability assessment methodology and ensure it measures how a factory actually performs — demonstrated process capability, yield, capacity and delivery — against Cohu's quality, delivery and cost needs. Drive new supplier selection through a disciplined qualification process grounded in demonstrated manufacturing capability observed on site. Align supplier capability to the Cohu product roadmap: identify early where the supply base cannot build what Cohu is designing and close the gap before launch. Lead structured problem solving and improvement projects at suppliers using Lean/TPS and Six Sigma methods, coaching supplier teams to sustain the gains rather than issuing findings and moving on. Direct the activities of the Supplier Development Engineers in Asia and partner with the worldwide Quality, Supply Chain and Engineering teams to engage the supplier base and drive improvements. Support the manufacturing of complex parts and sub-assemblies by providing technical expertise and support to suppliers. Review supplier manufacturing processes to ensure they will yield parts compliant to engineering drawings and specifications. Create and participate in PFMEA activities, work instruction improvements, and control plan effectiveness with suppliers. Track supplier performance indicators and use them to decide where to deploy the team's engineering effort, not simply to report status. Create and execute a strategic improvement plan at each key supplier and build the Supplier Development playbook that makes the approach repeatable across the team. Drive cross-functional engagement to remove roadblocks necessary to improve supplier performance. Eliminate risks that will prevent suppliers from meeting performance targets, and escalate as needed. Represent Cohu credibly to supplier executives — plant managers, operations leaders and owners — as a peer who has run manufacturing operations at their scale. Note on the nature of this role: this is a manufacturing leadership position, not a supplier quality or audit position. The successful candidate has run factories and improved them and brings deep expertise in a specific manufacturing process. Candidates whose experience consists primarily of assessing suppliers against checklists and surveys will not be a fit. Our Ideal Candidate: Bachelor's Degree in Engineering or equivalent. 15+ years in manufacturing, with direct line responsibility for running production strongly preferred — Plant Manager, Manufacturing Director, Operations Director, or Manufacturing Engineering Director of a significant factory. Careers built primarily in supplier auditing to checklists are unlikely to meet the bar for this role. Demonstrated ability to walk into an unfamiliar factory and judge quickly and accurately how well it is run, and to explain that judgment in terms of flow, constraints, equipment capability, changeover, maintenance and shop-floor management. Deep, hands-on expertise in at least one core manufacturing process — precision machining, plating and surface finishing, mechanical or electro-mechanical assembly, sheet metal fabrication, molding, or weldments — at a level that earns immediate credibility with a supplier's process engineers. Experience building an organization from scratch, or substantially scaling one: defining roles, hiring, developing engineers, and establishing operating processes where none existed. Ownership of manufacturing cost structure, capacity planning, or P&L for a factory or major production area. At least 5 years of managerial experience leading engineering or manufacturing teams, including teams at multiple sites, preferably in a global corporation. Experience in an industrial equipment, semiconductor, automotive, aerospace or medical device manufacturing environment. Applied experience with Lean / Toyota Production System and Six Sigma, evidenced by results delivered on a factory floor. Certification (Black Belt, TPS) is welcome but secondary to a demonstrated track record. Working knowledge of quality and APQP tools (PFMEA, control plan, SPC, MSA) as a means of driving manufacturing improvement. Able to read technical drawings and documentation (GD&T). Experience performing production readiness and rate readiness reviews and assessments. Experience working directly with suppliers in Asia, and willingness to travel internationally on a regular basis. Ability to interface effectively at every level, from machine operator and process engineer to supplier executive and Cohu leadership. Proven problem-solving skills, including the ability to interpret business performance and financial data, define actions, and implement solutions. Effective collaboration skills to motivate and influence others at various levels without a direct reporting relationship. Strong communication skills, both verbal and written.

Proven ability to own and drive technical direction end-to-end — not just advise, but decide and be accountable for outcomes. Extreme ownership mindset — no blame-shifting, no bystander behaviour. If it's in your domain, it's yours. Demonstrated commitment to growing people: a track record of engineers you've developed who went on to take on greater responsibility. Fluent in both Vietnamese and English — you will operate in a Vietnamese-speaking team environment while communicating across a global, English-speaking leadership group. Based in or willing to relocate to Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam. Strongly Preferred Experience in Poker or Live Casino domains — system architecture, operational complexity, or product delivery. Background in B2B or platform engineering within iGaming — integrations, shared services, operator-facing systems. Familiarity with iGaming regulatory frameworks (MGA, UKGC, or equivalent) and the technical implications of compliance. Experience working in distributed, multi-office engineering organizations. Track record of introducing or scaling new engineering practices, tools, or AI-assisted workflows across a team. Technical Depth Expected Backend systems design: distributed architecture, event-driven systems, high-availability design, data modeling. Platform infrastructure awareness: deployment pipelines, containerization, observability, incident management. Security-aware engineering — especially in the context of gaming platform integrity and fraud prevention. Comfort with modern engineering tooling and willingness to drive adoption. LEADERSHIP PROFILE We are not looking for a manager who oversees engineers. We are looking for a technical leader who is respected by engineers — someone who can go deep when it matters, elevate the people around them, and take full ownership of outcomes without needing direction from above. The right candidate is: Extreme ownership — takes full responsibility for outcomes in their domain. Does not deflect, does not wait, does not qualify accountability. A builder of psychological safety — actively creates an environment where people speak up, surface problems early, share mistakes openly, and challenge up the chain without fear. Invested in people growth — measures personal success partly by how much the people around them improve. Coaching and mentoring are not side tasks; they are leadership outputs. Self-directed and proactive — identifies problems before they escalate, drives solutions without waiting to be asked. Outcome-oriented — measures success by what ships, what works, and what improves; not by effort or activity. Opinionated but open — holds strong technical views, defends them with evidence, and updates them when presented with better information. Comfortable with ambiguity — operates effectively when the answer is not obvious and the scope is not fully defined. A continuous learner — actively seeks exposure to new tools, approaches, and ideas; brings relevant insight back to the team.

review_candidates.description: We’re looking for a Customer Support Team Lead to join 360 Mind in Vilnius. This isn’t a traditional Customer Support Team Lead role. Our support operation is increasingly powered by AI and automation and we’re looking for someone who can take ownership of the whole function: understand what’s happening behind the numbers, continuously improve our support flows, manage a small outsourced team and make the operation increasingly efficient and autonomous. Your goal? Build a support function that works so well it doesn’t need constant supervision. What you’ll own Own and improve our AI driven support setup by maintaining, testing and optimizing Octocom flows that handle a significant share of customer requests Drive automation by identifying repetitive work, bottlenecks and opportunities to replace manual processes with AI Manage our outsourced support team, owning performance, 1:1s, quality and day to day coordination Own support performance and analyze weekly trends to understand customer behavior, recurring issues, transaction patterns and opportunities to improve the overall support experience Turn insights into action by improving AI flows, support processes and how the team handles different customer cases Step into customer cases when needed, especially when they require hands on involvement, judgment or a more personalized approach Work cross functionally with Webutation and Product to bring customer insights into planning and improve checkout and cancellation flows Solve ad-hoc operational problems, from customer segmentation to prioritizing and orchestrating refund cases Continuously improve Customer Support to make the function leaner, faster and increasingly autonomous What we’re looking for Have experience leading Customer Support operations or teams and are comfortable taking full ownership of the function Have hands on experience with AI, automation or automated customer support workflows Naturally look at a manual process and ask: how can we automate this? Are comfortable working with support metrics and using data to identify problems and prioritize improvements Can be the point of contact and owner of the support function rather than waiting for someone else to define what needs to happen Are proactive and comfortable making decisions independently Have strong attention to detail, especially when working with refunds, cancellations and customer impacting processesAre trustworthy and comfortable owning areas where mistakes can directly affect customers and the business Can work effectively with both outsourced agents and internal Product/Operations teams What we offer Salary starting from €3,300 gross/month, depending on your experience. One of the most rewarding bonus structures in the market - your earnings scale directly with your results, with no ceiling. Hit your performance targets, and the upside is yours. The better you perform, the more you earn. Real growth opportunities - work closely with a small, experienced founding team where you can suggest ideas, test them with hundreds of thousands of customers globally, and see the impact firsthand. You’ll grow professionally while directly shaping our culture, product and future. Hybrid work model - 4 days together + 1 flexible day to keep the team connected, plus an additional 15-30 flexible workdays per year to work where it suits you best. Extra vacation days - earn additional time off through quarterly perks and work anniversaries. Pet-friendly office - bring your furry friend along and make the workday a little more fun. An office designed by us, for us - we’re constantly improving and adapting our space, and your crazy ideas for making it even better are always welcome. Team days & workations - from nights out in town to forest cabins, hikes, and the long spa getaways our team loves. Sometimes chill, sometimes a little wild, but always a good reset together. We’ll reach out to the candidates who seem like the best fit 🧡 so hit apply, we’d love to hear from you!

Key accountabilities: Drive sales growth by leveraging technical expertise in marine products, building strong client relationships, and implementing effective sales strategies. Identify and target potential clients and business opportunities. Build and maintain strong relationships with existing and new clients. Develop and implement strategic business plans to achieve revenue and growth targets. Conduct market research to identify market trends, competitor analysis, and customer needs. Visit customers and clients to understand their needs and requirements, and provide demonstrations of products wherever necessary. Research and identify new business opportunities, including new markets, growth areas, trends, customers, partnerships, products, and services. Prepare and present sales proposals, negotiate terms, and finalize contracts with clients, ensuring compliance with company policies and standards. Cultivate, build, and maintain strong relationships with new and existing clients, understanding their needs and providing tailored solutions to enhance customer satisfaction. Handle local purchases required for the smooth operation of the branch. Ensure timely procurement of necessary equipment and supplies. Oversee logistics and supply chain operations to ensure timely and efficient delivery of products to customers. Supervise warehouse operations, including ensuring accurate and timely inventory management and order fulfillment, while also ensuring the showroom is well-maintained. Ensure brand consistency and integrity across all branch activities, including marketing campaigns, promotions, and customer interactions, to enhance brand recognition and reputation in the market. Act as a liaison between the assigned branch and the other branches of the business. Secondary duties: Identify suitable office locations for setting up the new branch. Assist in the hiring process and facilitate visa processes for new employees if required. Collaborate with the IT department to address technical issues and implement necessary upgrades. Other responsibilities: Ensure compliance with all applicable laws, regulations, and industry standards. Collaborate with legal counsel to address legal issues, contracts, and agreements, and mitigate legal risks. Foster a culture of innovation and continuous improvement within the branch, encouraging staff members to identify and implement new ideas, processes, and technologies to enhance productivity and competitiveness. Qualifications: Bachelor’s/Masters degree in Marine Engineering, Business Administration, Sales & Marketing, or a related discipline. Technical knowledge of marine products, equipment, systems, or related industry applications. Strong understanding of sales, business development, commercial operations, and customer relationship management. Knowledge of local commercial, regulatory, and compliance requirements relevant to branch operations. Strong proficiency in Microsoft Office and business management/CRM systems. Experience: 8–12 years of progressive experience in sales, business development, commercial management, or branch/country operations, preferably within the marine, maritime, marine equipment, or related technical industry. Proven experience in driving revenue growth, developing new markets, and managing key customer relationships. Experience in technical sales, product/equipment sales and solution-based selling, with the ability to understand customer requirements and translate technical specifications into appropriate commercial solutions. To apply, send CVs to jobs@exalto-emirates.com
